candidates.formal_type:
∀ {r : Nat} (𝒜 : Fin r → Type u_1) [inst : (i : Fin r) → Ring.{u_1} (𝒜 i)] (V : Type u_2)
  [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} ((i : Fin r) → 𝒜 i) V],
  Iff (IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} ((i : Fin r) → 𝒜 i) V)
    (Exists.{1} fun i =>
      And
        (IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} (𝒜 i)
          (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x =>
            Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2}
              (LinearMap.range.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem3_3_3.idemProj.{u_1, u_2} 𝒜 V i)) x))
        (∀ (j : Fin r),
          Ne.{1} j i →
            Eq.{u_2 + 1} (LinearMap.range.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} (Etingof.Problem3_3_3.idemProj.{u_1, u_2} 𝒜 V j))
              Bot.bot.{u_2}))

rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: An A-representation V is irreducible exactly when 1_i V is irreducible over A_i for exactly one i and every other 1_j V vanishes.
